mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS id, s.dept_id AS 'deptId', s.tenant_id AS 'tenantId', s.merchant_id AS 'merchantId', s.role_id AS 'roleId', s.subject_type AS 'subjectType', r.auth AS 'roleAuth', u.username AS 'username', u.`password` AS 'password', u.real_name AS 'realName', u.nickname AS 'nickName', u.email as 'email', u.avatar AS 'avatar', u.`status` AS 'status', u.gender AS 'gender' FROM sys_user AS u INNER JOIN sys_user_subject s ON s.user_id = u.id AND s.status = 1 INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = s.role_id WHERE u.id = #{uId}

SELECT u.id AS id, s.dept_id AS 'deptId', s.tenant_id AS 'tenantId', s.merchant_id AS 'merchantId', s.role_id AS 'roleId', s.subject_type AS 'subjectType', r.auth AS 'roleAuth', u.username AS 'username', u.`password` AS 'password', u.real_name AS 'realName', u.nickname AS 'nickName', u.email as 'email', u.avatar AS 'avatar', u.`status` AS 'status', u.gender AS 'gender' FROM sys_user AS u INNER JOIN sys_user_subject s ON s.user_id = u.id AND s.status = 1 INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = s.role_id WHERE u.username = #{username}

SELECT u.id AS id, s.dept_id AS 'deptId', s.tenant_id AS 'tenantId', s.merchant_id AS 'merchantId', s.role_id AS 'roleId', s.subject_type AS 'subjectType', r.auth AS 'roleAuth', u.username AS 'username', u.`password` AS 'password', u.real_name AS 'realName', u.nickname AS 'nickName', u.email as 'email', u.avatar AS 'avatar', u.`status` AS 'status', u.gender AS 'gender' FROM sys_user AS u INNER JOIN sys_user_subject s ON s.user_id = u.id AND s.status = 1 INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = s.role_id WHERE u.email = #{email}
SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM sys_user WHERE email = #{email}

select t3.auth_code from sys_user_subject t1 left join sys_role_menu t2 on t1.role_id = t2.role_id left join sys_menu t3 on t2.menu_id = t3.id where t1.user_id = #{userId} AND auth_code IS NOT NULL AND auth_code != ''
and t3.type in
#{type}
order by t3.sort asc
select t2.dept_id from sys_user_subject t1, sys_role_data_scope t2 where t1.user_id = #{value} and t1.role_id = t2.role_id
select id from sys_dept where FIND_IN_SET(#{id}, pids)
